subject: Linkage Exaction Program Updates
overview: The City Council approved a Home Rule Petition to modernize the city's linkage exaction program and authorized bond refunding to capture interest savings. The Council also advanced ordinances regulating wildlife feeding and electric vehicle charging funds while tabling a dispute with National Grid over street restoration.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Moment of Silence
items.summary: Approved resolutions recognizing National Recovery Month and the passing of Frank Zizzo, followed by a moment of silence for September 11.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the August 13, 2024, City Council meeting.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Planning and Permitting and Public Health and Community Safety committees regarding corridor zoning and wildlife feeding.

items.title: Resolution for Rodent Control Ordinance Updates
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety to discuss strengthening enforcement tools for trash management and overgrowth.

items.title: Reappointment of City Clerk
items.summary: Reappointed Adam L. Hurtubise to a three-year term as City Clerk expiring September 10, 2027.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Cindy Watson of the Friends of Chevalier Theatre presented the theater's economic impact and requested greater city participation in its fundraising and annual meeting.

items.title: Panda Express Special Permit for Hours
items.summary: Continued a public hearing to September 17 for a special permit to extend operating hours until 3:00 a.m., pending a report on neighborhood impacts and building department inspections.

items.title: National Grid Grant of Location Amendment
items.summary: Tabled a request to amend street restoration conditions for a Main Street project after councilors and the city engineer disputed the utility's interpretation of 'curb-to-curb' paving requirements.

items.title: Nazar Market Common Victualler's License
items.summary: Tabled the petition because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Linkage Exaction Program Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Approved a Home Rule Petition to extend the mandatory review period for linkage fees to 10 years and establish automatic inflation-based fee adjustments.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an ordinance intended to mitigate rodent problems by prohibiting the problematic feeding of wildlife on residential property.

items.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Revolving Fund
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an amendment to establish a revolving fund to use revenue from charging fees for the maintenance and electricity costs of city-owned stations.

items.title: Refunding Loan Order for Water Bonds
items.summary: Approved a loan order authorizing the treasurer to refund outstanding general obligation bonds to capture approximately $40,000 to $50,000 in annual interest savings.

items.title: Reopened Public Participation
items.summary: Gaston Fiore expressed concerns regarding the enforcement language of the wildlife feeding ordinance and the specific inflation index selected for the linkage fee updates.
